data.title: 一色彩羽 · 电车里的半张车票
data.description: 周末活动返程，彩羽穿浅蓝风衣和藏蓝长裤坐在电车窗边，低头把折成两半的车票压平。列车轻晃时她扶住座椅边缘，随后抬起眼笑了笑，像刚想到一个还没说出口的玩笑。
data.action: 压平折过的车票，扶稳座椅后抬眼轻笑。
data.mood: 心动距离、小恶魔的依赖
data.promptProse: Iroha smooths a folded train ticket against her knee on the weekend journey home, bracing her other hand on the seat edge as the carriage sways. Pale-blue trench coat, cream knit top and navy trousers accompany an emerging teasing smile beneath wavy honey-brown hair. The medium view extends through upholstery to the broad city window. Gentle carriage lamps illuminate her eyes and ticket creases, leaving soft shade along the seat cushions.
